description: This file contains the implementation of the ClassLoader class in the Composer Autoload namespace, responsible for managing class autoloading using PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap strategies.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a flexible autoloading mechanism supporting PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap strategies, managing class file locations and registration in PHP.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class or interface given its name by locating its file and including it.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Finds the filesystem path to the file where a class is defined.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Searches for a class file with the specified extension using PSR-0 and PSR-4 rules.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers this ClassLoader instance as a PHP autoloader.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters this ClassLoader instance from PHP autoloaders.
